ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels estimated at approximately 0.15:0.85 across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels occupy the central core and lower regions of both lobes. Mid-intensity mottled gray pixels populate the upper interior. High-intensity pixels are clustered at the extreme lateral distal tips and scattered as discrete points (scars) and lines (scratches) across the darker ground.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression. Calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees. Bounding box depth is significant, extending approximately 60 pixels into the fluke body from the trailing edge apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations near the notch, transitioning to low-frequency, high-amplitude irregular jagged edges towards the distal ends, heavily influenced by external calcified attachments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a sigmoid-like curve: initially concave departing the notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular clusters at the distal tips. Right lobe interior features approximately 4-5 discrete white circular rings. Left lobe interior shows 2-3 smaller white circular detections.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible as high-contrast white linear segments. Left lobe: one prominent ~45-degree diagonal mark, two horizontal parallel segments. Right lobe: three distinct unaligned marks in the upper quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustation (barnacles) on both lobe tips. Multiple healed rake marks and circular depressions consistent with lamprey or cookie-cutter shark scars.
other_distinctive_markers: The extent of barnacle colonization is atypical, forming a continuous calcified ridge along the outermost 10% of the trailing edge on both lobes.
